requirements.evidence: Contract routes all present with right names/methods/middleware (routes/web.php:849-868, password.email throttle:6,1, verification.verify signed). Login validates email:strict, rate-limits lowercase email+IP at 5 and uses auth.failed/auth.throttle on email, regenerates session and redirectIntended to home (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:30-56). Register uses key Str::transliterate('register|'.ip), Password::defaults(), fires Registered, logs in, regenerates (Register.php:45-70). Reset rotates remember_token and fires PasswordReset (ResetPasswordController.php:38-44); reset view has a single name="email" input. User implements MustVerifyEmail; EmailVerificationRequest gives 403 on tampered id; resend skips verified users. .env.example and phpunit.xml locale pins added; ui.php in both locales with 'Entrar', 'Senha', 'Esqueceu a senha?'. Gaps: #[Title('Login')]/#[Title('Register')] are hardcoded English strings (Login.php:230, Register.php:297); register lockout reuses the login-specific auth.throttle text; the requirement to fix hardcoded href/action in existing views is not addressed in the diff (welcome/bulma-test untouched).

conventions.evidence: TDD convention ('No production code without a test') violated: no test files added. No docs/CHANGELOG update. Repeated Bulma field markup (label/control/input/@error) copied across login.blade.php, register.blade.php, forgot-password.blade.php, reset-password.blade.php instead of an anonymous Blade component. User creation done directly in the Livewire component rather than through app/Actions. Positives: #[Validate] + $this->validate() in Livewire, plain wire:model, route() for all links, Bulma classes.

security.evidence: Rate limiting inside Livewire actions (Login.php:245-261, Register.php:325-337), session regenerate on login/register, logout invalidates + regenerateToken (LogoutController.php:203-206), forgot-password always returns passwords.sent (ForgotPasswordController.php:95-97), remember_token rotated on reset, signed+throttled verify link via EmailVerificationRequest, all output escaped with {{ }}, $fillable on User. Minor: layout falls back to loading Bulma from a third-party CDN without SRI (layouts/app.blade.php:700); register only hits the limiter after successful validation so failed attempts (e.g. email enumeration via unique rule) are unthrottled.

tests.evidence: The diff adds no Pest/PHPUnit tests at all; the only test file touched is tests/Feature/BulmaTest.php (removal of an unused import). No coverage of login/register/throttle/reset/verification/locale requirements, nor the unauthorized-call/tamper tests required for Livewire actions.

simplicity.evidence: Controllers are short and direct. Register declares rules twice: #[Validate] attributes (Register.php:300-310) and an identical rules() method (Register.php:313-321), then calls validate($this->rules()) explicitly. Layout mixes @yield('content') and {{ $slot ?? '' }} plus a CDN fallback branch (layouts/app.blade.php:697-708). Form field markup duplicated across four views.

readability.evidence: Clear controller/class names and small methods; views consistent. The duplicated validation in Register.php with a comment explaining only half of it is confusing; hardcoded English #[Title] values that are never rendered (layout uses config('app.name')).

scope.evidence: Mostly on task. Unrelated edits: bootstrap/providers.php import refactor (lines 424-431), quote/newline reformatting in lang/pt_BR/{auth,pagination,passwords,validation}.php, and unused-import removal in tests/Feature/BulmaTest.php — likely Pint output, small.

issues.explanation: The change ships an entire auth system with zero tests, violating the project's mandatory TDD rule and leaving every requirement (throttling, tampered verify link 403, locale strings, remember_token rotation) unverified.
Requirement 9 explicitly extends the route()-only rule to existing views, but the diff does not touch them, so any hardcoded hrefs there remain.
#[Title('Login')] / #[Title('Register')] are hardcoded English text, contrary to 'all screen text comes from translation files'.
Validation rules are declared both as #[Validate] attributes and in rules(), and validate() is called with rules() explicitly — duplicated, divergent-prone definitions.
The limiter is only hit after validation succeeds, so repeated failed submissions (e.g. probing the unique email rule) are never throttled.
Identical Bulma form-field markup is copy-pasted across four views instead of an anonymous Blade component as the conventions require.
No docs or CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry for a new auth feature, contrary to the docs-in-sync convention.
Falls back to loading Bulma from jsdelivr without SRI, an unrequested third-party asset dependency.
Register lockout reuses auth.throttle whose pt-BR text says 'Muitas tentativas de login', which is misleading on the registration page.
Formatting-only edits to files unrelated to the feature.

review.summary: The change implements session auth (Livewire login/register, logout, password reset, e-mail verification, pt-BR localization) and largely satisfies the routing and behavioral contract with sound security choices. However it ships no tests whatsoever despite the project's mandatory TDD rule, skips the existing-view route() cleanup, duplicates validation and form markup, and does not update docs, so it needs substantial rework before approval.
